assets.alt: 一个人放心地闭眼微微后倾，信任身后的朋友稳稳扶住自己
assets.scene: Two adult friends practice a gentle trust exercise at ground level on a soft grassy lawn. The person in front closes their eyes peacefully and leans back just a little into the reliable friend's waiting hands; the person behind stands securely and already supports their shoulders with both hands. The front person's relaxed face and open hands show they confidently rely on their friend. Both keep their feet on the ground, no fall, no height, no danger. Make relying on someone obvious, not romantic hugging.
assets.context: I trust you to make a good choice. 我相信你会做出好的选择。
